'''Accudrop Stun Gas''' was a type of [[Stun gas|knockout gas]] that caused effects ranging from slowed reactions to unconsciousness in many different [[Species/Legends|species]] when inhaled. The gas was sometimes utilized as a payload in [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]] [[Type-12B Hollow-Tip Rocket|Type 12-B Hollow-Tip Rockets]], a type of [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] ammunition in use before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and into the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. At some point during his career, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] made use of the rockets containing Accudrop Stun Gas in his [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]].

==Properties==
Upon inhalation, Accudrop [[Stun gas|Stun Gas]] could cause effects ranging from slowed reaction [[Time/Legends|times]] to unconsciousness in a variety of [[Species/Legends|species]]. When released into the air, the gas dissipated quickly, a process that took only several [[Standard second|seconds]] for the amount contained in a [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]] [[Type-12B Hollow-Tip Rocket|Type 12-B Hollow-Tip Rocket]],<ref name="AEG" /> which was also identified as a Type-12B capsule.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:BobaFettMain2.png|thumb|left|220px|The bounty hunter Boba Fett used Accudrop Stun Gas during his career.]]
At some point before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="AEGera" /> Accudrop Stun Gas was one payload utilized in Locris Syndicated Securities Type 12-B Hollow-Tip [[Missile/Legends|Rockets]],<ref name="AEG" /> which saw use into the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> The rockets were a type of ammunition used in the [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]], a [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] [[wrist rocket launcher]],<ref name="AEG" /> and the [[Model RDP-12 Rocket Launcher]] produced by [[Locris Syndicates/Legends|Locris Syndicates]].<ref name="GG10" /> Designed to incapacitate or slow down a group of targets, the rockets filled with Accudrop Stun Gas were capable of spreading a cloud of the gas over a two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius when they released their payload.<ref name="AEG" />

Adding Accudrop Stun Gas to one of the rockets increased the price to 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as opposed to the 200-credit price of the empty rockets.<ref name="Cost" /> While the rockets filled with Accudrop Stun Gas were quite common, the sale and ownership of the rockets were restricted to those with the appropriate license and government approval.<ref name="AEG" /> The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] utilized the rockets that contained Accudrop Stun Gas in his MM9 rocket system at some point during his career,<ref name="W&Tinfo">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' states that [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]] made use of a number of [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] with descriptions that correspond exactly to those listed for the MM9 rocket system in ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''. Therefore, this article asserts that the [[stun gas]] contained in Fett's rockets is Accudrop Stun Gas.</ref> which started during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and continued into the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] over six [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later.<ref name="FettDate">[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] spans from at least [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], according to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]," to at least [[44 ABY]], according to ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Arms-and-equipment-guide.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Accudrop Stun Gas was first identified in the ''Arms & Equipment Guide''.]]
A type of stun gas was mentioned as part of the MM9 rocket system entry in ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', a [[1997]] reference book written by [[Bill Smith]]. The stun gas was described as the payload for a rocket in a list of rockets utilized by Boba Fett.<ref name="W&T">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> In [[2002]], ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook|revised edition]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', included a side bar for the MM9 rocket system that included<ref name="AEG" /> the ammunition mentioned in ''The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology''<ref name="W&T" /> with names for each ammunition type. In this section, the stun gas received the name Accudrop Stun Gas and was identified as a payload for Locris Syndicated Securities Type 12-B Hollow Tip Rockets. However, the book did not specify whether Locris Syndicated Securities created the stun gas or if it was produced by another company and added to the rockets.<ref name="AEG" /> In [[1998]], Bill Smith's "[[Boba Fett's Armor: An Essential Guide to a Walking Weapon]]" in the ''[[Star Wars: Boba Fett]]'' magazine referred to the rockets as Type-12B Stun Rockets but did not explicitly mention the stun gas.<ref name="Walking Weapon">{{StoryCite|story=Boba Fett's Armor: An Essential Guide to a Walking Weapon|book=Star Wars: Boba Fett}}</ref>

From the information given in ''Arms and Equipment Guide'', the only era when Accudrop Stun Gas was confirmed to be in use was the [[Rise of the Empire era]], which is the only era listed for the MM9 rocket system.<ref name="AEG" /> However, while Accudrop Stun Gas was not seen, Boba Fett carried the MM9 rocket system during the Rise of the Empire era, [[Rebellion era]], [[New Republic era]], [[New Jedi Order era]], and [[Legacy era]].<ref name="MM9">Based on the appearance of the MM9 rocket system in ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', the MM9 rocket system is shown in Boba Fett's possession on the cover of ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'', in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in ''[[Boba Fett: Murder Most Foul]]'', in "[[Revenants]]," and on the back cover of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''. These sources occur during the [[Rise of the Empire era]], [[Rebellion era]], [[New Republic era]], [[New Jedi Order era]], and [[Legacy era]], respectively.</ref> Also, the rockets that used the gas as a payload were confirmed to be used in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] era by ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'',<ref name="GG10" /> with ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' also confirming their use during New Republic era. Neither ''Gundark's Fantastic Technology''<ref name="Gundark" /> nor ''Galaxy Guide 10'' included Accudrop Stun Gas as a payload for the rockets.<ref name="GG10" />
